items.name: Hands on Table, Problems on Back-(consept)
items.description:
😅 Why This LoRA Exists

Apparently, asking an AI model to generate a pose where a woman has her hands on a table while someone is grabbing her legs from behind, and her legs are wrapped around their waist, was just too ambitious for most models.
So... I fixed that. You're welcome.

🎯 What This LoRA Does

This LoRA is trained to accurately represent a dynamic and intimate pose involving:

  • Woman leaning forward on a table

  • Partner standing behind and holding her legs

  • Her legs wrapped around their waist

  • Slight floating effect in some variations

  • Works from both side or above camera angles

It's ideal for stylized scenes, storytelling frames, or just testing how far your model can go with body dynamics.

🧩 Trigger Word

hotpobxl

Use this word in your prompt to activate the LoRA’s effect.

🔖 Suggested Tags

leaning on table, legs grab, grabbing from behind, legs around waist, floating, leg around partner, from side, from above

These tags help guide the model to properly compose the intended pose and angle. Feel free to experiment for your own creative results!

⚙️ Recommended Weights

  • 0.8 → for subtle integration

  • 1.0 → ✅ recommended for full effect

🙏 Support & Thanks

Training this LoRA took a lot of time and GPU resources. I truly appreciate every donation 💖 — it helps me create more oddly specific and fun LoRAs like this one.

🎨 Show Me What You Got

I'm super excited to see what you come up with using this pose!
Tag me or share your results — I’d love to see the creativity this inspires
